# Five-day forecast

The forecast comparison is incomplete: 2 of 22 group/phase cells have every expected window. There are 31056 comparable old-lead scalar values; 0 differ, with maximum absolute difference 0 km. Day-4/day-5 accuracy is descriptive. The required new statements were omitted from stage-1 registration before scoring, so the prospective-test requirement failed (see experiments/five-day-ca/REGISTRATION-FAILURE.md). CA reach, synthetic alerts and proper scores have not been measured, so these results cannot establish a five-day CA capability. Frozen covariance failures remain unresolved; no covariance was refitted.

Only aggregates are published. Rows and input hashes remain in the archive. Incomplete cells are progress counts, not completed-group estimates.
